title: [main] Hidden breaking change and instability on sales/purchase line insert
summary: Fixed unreliable header existence checks for sales and purchase line insertion by renaming the control variable, adding an explicit verification procedure, and providing a dedicated method to suppress the check. These changes resolve false-positive errors while preventing invalid inserts.
key_points: Renamed HasSalesHeader and HasPurchaseHeader variables to SuppressSalesHeaderExistsVerification and SuppressPurchaseHeaderExistsVerification to clarify intent
Added SetSuppressSalesHeaderExistsVerification() and SetSuppressPurchaseHeaderExistsVerification() procedures as alternatives to SetSalesHeader() and SetPurchaseHeader()
Implemented explicit header existence checks in VerifySalesHeaderExists() and VerifyPurchaseHeaderExists() instead of relying on GetSalesHeader() and GetPurchaseHeader()
Skip verification for temporary sales and purchase lines
Retained original parameter names in OnBeforeGetSalesHeader() and OnBeforeGetPurchaseHeader() events to avoid breaking changes
